sources.label: Morphe android app patches (for apps that I use) - stable releases
sources.author: bearinmind
patch_list: Never learns from what you type.
Shows GIPHY GIFs in every language.
Lets the keyboard be resized smaller and taller.
Builds SBoard, its own keyboard app with its own name and icon.
Renames Samsung Keyboard, so the two keyboards can be told apart.
Installs next to the system Samsung Keyboard under its own package name.
Turns off Samsung Analytics, crash reports and typed-text collection.
Makes Samsung Keyboard usable on non-One UI ROMs.
Backspace deletes twice as fast at every speed.
Halves the suggestion bar's animation time.
Removes the Bitmoji and mojitok sticker services.
Removes Galaxy AI from the toolbar, stickers and settings.
Removes the "new" dots from the toolbar and emoji tabs.
Removes the Samsung Pass button from the toolbar.
Removes the Galaxy Store sticker button and Contact us.
Removes the Translate button from the toolbar.
Adds a key vibration length slider to Touch feedback (One UI).
Shows more buttons on the toolbar before the ... button.
Removes the contacts permission (names in suggestions).
Stops GIPHY and Tenor view and share pings.
Offers the one-handed keyboard mode on every phone.
Makes the Dark and Solid dark themes pure black.
Keeps the keyboard offline. GIFs, stickers, translation, AI tools and language downloads stop working.
Shows the GIF board where the phone's region turns it off.
Ignores keyboard policies pushed from Samsung's servers.

sources.author: Heval
patch_list: Never learns from what you type.
Shows GIPHY GIFs in every language.
Shows password and autofill suggestions even when the field already has text.
Keeps more items in the clipboard history.
Renames Samsung Keyboard, so the two keyboards can be told apart.
Installs next to the system Samsung Keyboard under its own package name.
Sets how many columns the clipboard panel has, and how many recent items its top row shows.
Turns off Samsung Analytics, crash reports and typed-text collection.
Makes Samsung Keyboard usable on non-One UI ROMs.
Stops GIPHY and Tenor view and share pings.
Offers the one-handed keyboard, for non-Samsung phones.
Adds a screen to turn supported features on or off.
Keeps the keyboard offline. GIFs, stickers, translation, AI tools and language downloads stop working.
Brings back the vibration on key taps, for non-Samsung phones.
Shows the GIF board where the phone's region turns it off.
Ignores keyboard policies pushed from Samsung's servers.
Offers moving the cursor by swiping on the space bar, for non-Samsung phones.
Swipe down on the suggestion strip or toolbar to hide the keyboard.
Lets you place more items in the toolbar's top row; rearrange them in the toolbar editor.
